The term 'спада рязко' (drops sharply) is a subjective interpretation of the slope, which the prompt asks to avoid. A neutral description would state the change in values without such evaluative language.

The phrase 'продължава да намалява по-бавно' (continues to decrease more slowly) is a subjective comparison of the line's slope at different points. The prompt requires describing the visual information without such interpretations.
